attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: progress_photo_upload
steps:
  - id: step_receive_upload
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/photos/upload"
      method: "POST"
    output: raw_upload

  - id: step_authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "user"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_validate_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_upload
      schema:
        type: "progress_photo"
        required_fields:
          - image_data
          - upload_date
        optional_fields:
          - notes
        constraints:
          max_image_size_mb: 10
          allowed_formats:
            - "image/jpeg"
            - "image/png"
            - "image/webp"
    output: validated_upload

  - id: step_extract_user_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: auth_result
      field: "user_id"
    output: user_id

  - id: step_encrypt_photo
    op: encrypt_field
    params:
      input: validated_upload
      field: "image_data"
      algorithm: "AES-256"
    output: encrypted_upload

  - id: step_transform_record
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: encrypted_upload
      mapping:
        user_id: user_id
        image_data: "$.image_data"
        upload_date: "$.upload_date"
        notes: "$.notes"
        visibility: "private"
    output: photo_record

  - id: step_write_photo
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: photo_record
      table: "user_progress_photos"
      privacy: "private"
    output: write_result

  - id: step_log_upload
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: photo_record
      action: "progress_photo_uploaded"
      details:
        user_id: user_id
        timestamp: "$.upload_date"
        visibility: "private"

  - id: step_notify_user
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: photo_record
      template: "photo_upload_success"
      message: "Your progress photo has been uploaded and stored securely."
      channel: "in_app"

  - id: step_handle_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error: "step_terminate_failure"
      steps:
        - step_receive_upload
        - step_validate_schema
        - step_write_photo

  - id: step_terminate_failure
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failed"
      message: "Progress photo upload failed. Please try again."

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      message: "Progress photo uploaded and stored privately."
